summary.en: Hexagon-flavored arcade puzzler: spin a central hex to stack and clear incoming colored blocks.
summary.zh: 六边形版俄罗斯方块，下落的多边形围绕中心堆叠，越玩越上瘾。

description.en: Colored blocks fall inward on every face of the hexagon; rotate left and right to line up three or more of one color and clear them. Survive 60 seconds and everything speeds up — let the ring fill and it's done.
description.zh: 彩色方块从六边形外圈掉落，左右旋转让同色块三连以上消除。支撑 60 秒就会加速，堆到外圈即结束。

howto.en: Left/right arrow keys to rotate; swipe on touch screens.
howto.zh: 方向键控制旋转与落下，触屏可滑动。

tip.en: Distinctive visuals and lovely colors make it a natural signature game for the front page. The official demo site goes down now and then — host your own copy on GitHub Pages or your CDN.
tip.zh: 视觉辨识度高、配色漂亮，适合放在首页做「招牌游戏」。官方 demo 站点偶发不可用，建议 clone 后用 GitHub Pages 或自己的 CDN 重新托管一份。
